# Intention Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/IntentionTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that an agent held an intentional mode over an interval — a goal adopted in January and abandoned in June is an opened-then-closed tenure, never a deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). The [`StandpointTenure`](gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) idiom applied to teleology: use only when adoption / revision is itself worth modelling; the common case is a bare [`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) with [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md) on the statement. Carries its interval via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (temporal module); a withdrawn tenure is kept with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the reified half of the [`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) ↔ [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) pair: when adoption, revision, or abandonment of an intrinsic mode over an interval is itself the fact of interest, so the tenure can be opened and closed rather than mutated.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the 80% case where an agent simply holds a goal (use the flat [`gmeow:hasGoal`](../properties/gmeow-hasGoal.md) with [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md)) and for commitment tenure (a [`Commitment`](gmeow-Commitment.md) relator carries its own period by construction); never delete an abandoned tenure — close it and set [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Mint one [`IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md) per (agent, mode) holding, bind [`gmeow:tenureAgent`](../properties/gmeow-tenureAgent.md) and [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](../properties/gmeow-tenureIntention.md), scope it with [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md); record withdrawal by closing the interval and suppressing with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false rather than removing the triple.

### Examples

- ex:resolveTenure a [`gmeow:IntentionTenure`](gmeow-IntentionTenure.md); [`gmeow:tenureAgent`](../properties/gmeow-tenureAgent.md) ex:lillith; [`gmeow:tenureIntention`](../properties/gmeow-tenureIntention.md) ex:planToShip; [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) ex:firstHalfYear.
